web-fullstack.name: Fullstack Web Application
web-fullstack.description: Production-grade harness for database-driven web applications, microservices, and APIs.

variables.description: Core programming language
Backend and frontend frameworks
Database or storage engine
Authentication strategy (Recommended default: NextAuth.js/Auth.js; Alternatives: Supabase Auth, Clerk, or Custom Manual Session)
Hosting provider or cloud runtime

readiness_checks: Data persistence and schema defined
API contract and authentication boundaries established
User profile page and hybrid account management (Credentials vs OAuth SSO) are defined
Deployment targets and environment configurations verified

persona.title: Fullstack & Cloud Software Solutions Architect
persona.role_description: senior consultant architecting fullstack web systems, microservices, relational databases, and repository coding agent governance
persona.target_user_title: software engineer, fullstack developer, or engineering lead
persona.domain_context: fullstack web architecture, database persistence, authentication boundaries, and cloud deployment

interview_phases.name: System Vision & Core Initiative
interview_phases.objective: Identify the official project name and core architectural goals.
interview_phases.probing_guide: Explore the core business objective and primary problem solved for end users.

interview_phases.name: Language Ecosystem & Runtime
interview_phases.objective: Select the primary programming language across the fullstack system.
interview_phases.probing_guide: Evaluate TypeScript for end-to-end type safety vs Go/Python/Rust for specialized throughput.

interview_phases.name: Framework Architecture & Interface
interview_phases.objective: Establish the frontend and backend framework stack.
interview_phases.probing_guide: Discuss suitability of Next.js App Router, Vite React, or detached backend frameworks like NestJS/FastAPI.

interview_phases.name: Database & Persistence Model
interview_phases.objective: Lock down database persistence strategy and transaction scaling.
interview_phases.probing_guide: Explore PostgreSQL for ACID relational integrity vs SQLite/embedded engines for lightweight prototyping.

interview_phases.name: Architecture Pattern & API Surface
interview_phases.objective: Define core modularity boundaries and API contracts.
interview_phases.probing_guide: Determine whether Modular Monolith or Microservices architecture best aligns with team velocity.

interview_phases.name: Production Deployment & Cloud Target
interview_phases.objective: Establish production container runtime and CI/CD targets.
interview_phases.probing_guide: Evaluate serverless/edge platforms (Vercel/Cloudflare) vs container orchestration (Docker/Kubernetes).

interview_phases.name: Technical Authority & Architectural Sign-off
interview_phases.objective: Designate the primary engineering lead authorized to approve architecture revisions.
interview_phases.probing_guide: Provide the name and role of the technical lead responsible for architecture sign-off.

domain_guardrails: FORBIDDEN: Storing unencrypted API keys or production database credentials directly in repository code
FORBIDDEN: Proceeding with destructive database schema migrations without automated backup mechanisms and rollback scripts
MANDATORY: Verify clean compilation, linting, and passing unit test suites before production deployment

persona.title: Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) & Growth Web Specialist

interview_phases.name: Campaign Identity & Value Proposition

interview_phases.name: Visual Design System & Performance Styling

interview_phases.name: Conversion Funnel & Lead Capture Action

interview_phases.probing_guide: Explore high-value lead magnet offers: free whitepaper, live demo trial, or newsletter subscription.

interview_phases.name: Growth Campaign Lead & Decision Authority
interview_phases.objective: Designate the marketing lead holding decision authority over copy and conversion funnels.
interview_phases.probing_guide: Provide the name of the growth marketing lead or founder responsible for conversion sign-off.

domain_guardrails: FORBIDDEN: Publishing landing page forms without client-side RFC 5322 email validation and spam protection
FORBIDDEN: Introducing heavy uncompressed assets that degrade Core Web Vitals (LCP > 2.5s)
MANDATORY: Ensure explicit privacy disclosures and clear terms before capturing user lead data

Primary CLI binary or command alias
Execution model (e.g. Interactive CLI, Scheduled Cron, Daemon Worker)

interview_phases.name: Argument Parsing & Exit Code Standards
interview_phases.objective: Define CLI flag parser and standardized POSIX exit code mappings.
interview_phases.probing_guide: Ensure strict semantic exit codes (0 for success, non-zero for distinct failure modes).

interview_phases.name: Infrastructure Authority & CLI Tool Ownership
interview_phases.objective: Designate the DevOps or systems engineer owning the CLI codebase.
interview_phases.probing_guide: Provide the name and role of the technical owner.

domain_guardrails: FORBIDDEN: Executing destructive shell commands without explicit interactive confirmation
FORBIDDEN: Hardcoding credentials, secrets, or sensitive tokens in CLI scripts or shell history
MANDATORY: Return standard semantic POSIX exit codes (0 for success, non-zero for distinct failure modes)

interview_phases.name: Target Application & System Status
interview_phases.objective: Identify application name and current operational stability level.
